Company Overview

Planview has one mission: to close the gap between strategic intent and business outcome, providing the intelligence organizations need to act decisively.  

As the global leader in Strategic Portfolio Management, Planview helps organizations of all sizes achieve their business goals, faster and smarter. Our comprehensive platform bring initiatives, investments, and resources into a continuous, connected model of the business: the actionable understanding leaders need to move decisively, keep teams and AI in lockstep, and know how their initiatives are performing.—now powered by Planview Anvi, our next-generation enterprise AI that delivers expert guidance, intelligent recommendations, and actionable insights, turning complex data into decisive action from strategy through execution. 

Recognized as a Leader in the 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Strategic Portfolio Management for the fifth consecutive year, we proudly serve more than 3,000 customers globally, including 45% of the Fortune 100—and more than 3 million users worldwide. 

Why Join Planview? 

At Planview, our people’s connections drive our innovation and success. Our global team of 1,500+ employees work remotely and across offices in Austin, Vancouver, Hod HaSharon, Bangalore, Sydney, and Stockholm. We've built a world-class, connected culture rooted in shared values that empowers our teams to thrive and succeed from anywhere. When you join Planview, you're not just joining a company, you're joining a movement to transform how the world works. 

Discover more about our portfolio at planview.com, and connect with us on LinkedIn, Instagram, and X. 

#LI-HYBRID#LI-CG1

The Opportunity

We are seeking a Software Engineer I to join our Portfolio Intelligence team. This is an opportunity to launch your career in cloud-native engineering and agentic systems, working alongside experienced engineers and data scientists who will mentor you as you build your skills. You will contribute to building the Insight Engine, a system that runs insights which use a combination of data science and LLMs.

In this role, you will
Learn and Contribute
Work on well-defined tasks that build your foundational skills in cloud engineering and agentic systems, using C# on AWS. Contribute to components of the Insight Engine, including the services that run insights and the systems that evaluate them, working alongside data scientists to bring their work to production. Implement features and fixes under the guidance of senior engineers, learning to write clean, testable code that meets team standards. As you grow, you’ll take on increasingly complex work with greater independence.
Build Technical Foundations
Develop proficiency in our stack, including .NET Orleans, AWS Bedrock, PostgreSQL, and Snowflake, along with GenAI-powered development tools and workflows. Learn how highly available, scalable cloud services are designed, and how to tackle challenges like non-deterministic LLM output, eval quality, latency, and governance. Senior engineers will provide mentorship and code review to accelerate your growth.
Collaborate and Communicate
Work closely with senior engineers, product managers, and data scientists, asking questions and seeking feedback to accelerate your learning. Participate in team meetings, code reviews, and technical discussions. Communicate clearly about your progress, blockers, and what you're learning.
Develop Production Awareness
Learn our "You Build It, You Run It" culture by participating in on-call rotations with support from experienced team members. Develop an understanding of how production systems operate, how incidents are handled, and how monitoring and alerting help maintain platform reliability.

Who We Are Looking For
You are early in your career and eager to grow as an engineer. You have foundational programming skills and a curiosity about how cloud systems and LLM-powered products work. You learn quickly, ask good questions, and take feedback well.
You don’t need to have all the answers, just the motivation to find them. You’re looking for an environment where you can learn from experienced engineers, contribute meaningfully from day one, and build toward a long-term career.

What You'll Do

Required Qualifications
1-2 years of professional software development experience, or a recent graduate with relevant internship or co-op experience.
Proficiency in C# or a similar object-oriented language (such as Java).
Basic understanding of SQL and relational databases.
Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS preferred) through coursework, personal projects, or prior experience.
Exposure to working with LLMs in agentic development (for example, building agents or using agentic coding tools like Claude Code), through work, coursework, or personal projects.
Familiarity with version control (Git) and basic software development practices, including code review and automated testing.
Foundational knowledge of data structures and algorithms.
Strong communication skills and ability to work collaboratively.
Willingness to participate in on-call rotations and learn production operations practices.

What You'll Bring

These skills are not required on day one, but they are highly valued:
Experience calling LLM APIs, prompt design, or writing evals.
Experience with Python and the .NET Orleans framework.
Familiarity with REST APIs, and with CI/CD, Docker, and containerization concepts.
Interest in Generative AI and experience using AI-powered coding assistants (GitHub Copilot, Claude Code) for learning and productivity.
Expected Salary: 75,000 -100,000 CAD

Benefits at Planview

At Planview, you’ll join our global team and culture which reflects the vibrant communities in which our employees live and work. To support you at Planview, you will enjoy:

Unplugged Days: 4 company-wide paid days off per year to recharge and relax.
Generous PTO offerings (region dependent).
Region specific competitive benefit plans to support you at any life stage including parental leave, retirement, medical plans, wellness support, and remote work support.
Paid time to volunteer through Planview’s Force for Good Week.
Employee Referral bonus program.
Weekly office lunches for hybrid team members and social events.
Flexible work hours/environment.

Now is a great time to join our team. If you are looking for a place to grow your career, innovate with best-in-class solutions, and build the future of connected work, Planview is the right place for you!

AI Use in Recruitment

Planview may employ AI-based tools to support certain recruiting activities, however all decisions affecting a candidate's application are made by a human recruiter or hiring manager. Planview is committed to complying with applicable AI regulations, including the EU AI Act and other emerging legislation in the jurisdictions in which we operate, and reviews its AI practices as these requirements evolve. If you require further information or would like to exercise your rights under applicable privacy laws, please submit your request at the Planview Data Subject Access Request (DSAR) Portal.
